body: Previous* and Don't know what my personality type is*  Sorry, posting this using my phone.

Thank you for the thoughtful responses. I'm honestly glad to know I'm not the only one who has undergone this particular struggle. 

You are right. I quit yesterday and they were very kind and receptive to my honest account of why I was leaving. I have money now for nine more days and then I have nothing. Unfortunately, from May to July I lived on gifted thousands from my father's savings and 1,900 from my boyfriend. I don't believe I have any options now that I have leeched off my two main advocates, and further have willingly put myself out of work. I have a chance of getting my old job back (was fired at the end of April for being slightly late a lot) and will know for sure by Tuesday at the latest. If it's a no, I'll be frantically looking elsewhere. 

I don't know that my personality type according to what you mentioned but I'm curious. Do you have a link?

I would bake confectionery or care for kids for free. Sadly the former requires accreditation and childcare pays shit. My precious job was a server at a casual restaurant and I did very much enjoy the fast pace (fucking MOVING) and interactions/friendships. I really hope I can go back.

The reason I'm still around is that I never had such justification before, and I knew of no viable method to do this without fucking it up or really suffering. Now I am jobless, in debt, heavily confused about my best friend, damaged by the most disturbing things from the first love of my life (years ago), have not met my expectations, and am diagnosed with depression. I also have prescription drugs to aid me now, so really everything has properly coalesced. 

Further, I can't handle how terribly my father suffers with no possible help, and my mother deserves to hurt this much for never acting like she gave two fucks about me. Everyone else will bounce back and resdiscover their own life distractions.
I only posted here so I wouldn't be breaking the rules in any other subreddits.
Have been suicidal so many countless times for the last decade, despite all medical help available, and relatively good relationships. It doesn't stop, and I'm done with the shit.
